event.title: Dive Radio: Data vs. Intuition (Linear's Take), the Web Designer Is Back, Dialkit Rising + Live Call-Ins
event.description:
Linear once said great products come from intuition, not data, but that's not the whole story: we're digging into whether that's wisdom or survivorship bias. 

Then: why the "web designer" is suddenly a prestige role again (and what Vercel's doing with it), plus the Dialkit hype cycle: real tool or shiny object?

We're also crowning our Designer of the Week, and the Dive Line is open for the first time. Call in with your takes, questions, or something you shipped.

New episodes live every week. Drop a comment or call in. The best takes make the show.
